text: {"lessons":["My account value rose from 101,819 to 107,689 overall, despite monthly ups and downs; I should judge progress over time, not by one month's change.","Selling Stock A at a gain brought in cash, but gains on one stock do not by themselves show whether my overall portfolio is safer or better positioned.","I should keep trading infrequently and focus each decision on protecting retirement savings and avoiding swings I cannot comfortably tolerate."]}
